name: SMiLE Basic Web
author: smilecomunicacion

sections.description:
SMiLE Basic Web aggregates different functionalities for WordPress, starting with the advanced SMiLE Contact Form. This plugin provides a centralized interface where you can:

  • Configure a customizable contact form with SMTP settings for reliable email delivery.
  • Enable user copy functionality to send an email copy to the user.
  • Add custom fields with labels, placeholders, and required field indicators.
  • Include a privacy policy checkbox linked to a designated page.
  • Integrate Google reCAPTCHA v3 for spam protection.
  • Manage additional future functionalities under the same umbrella.

The SMiLE Contact Form is now a part of SMiLE Basic Web, accessible via a dedicated tab in the plugin settings. Embed the contact form on any page using the shortcode [smile_contact_form].

External services

This plugin integrates Google reCAPTCHA v3 to protect the contact form from spam and abuse.

What the service is and what it is used for:
Google reCAPTCHA v3 is a service that helps protect your website by analyzing user behavior to detect and block automated spam submissions in the contact form.

What data is sent and when:
When a user submits the contact form and reCAPTCHA v3 is enabled, a token is generated and sent to Google for verification. The verification request includes:
– The reCAPTCHA response token.
– The user’s IP address.
– The secret key from your reCAPTCHA settings.

Links to terms and privacy policy:
– Google Terms of Service
– Google Privacy PolicySMiLE Basic Web is actively maintained and regularly updated to ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress versions. If you find it useful, please consider donating to support development. Feedback and contributions are always welcome!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smile-basic-web plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in your WordPress admin area.
  3. Navigate to “SMiLE Basic Web” in the WordPress admin menu to configure various options, including the SMiLE Contact Form.
  4. For contact form settings, select the “SMiLE Contact Form” tab within the SMiLE Basic Web settings page.
  5. Insert the contact form into any page using the shortcode [smile_contact_form].
sections.faq:
What is SMiLE Basic Web?

SMiLE Basic Web is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that brings together several functionalities, starting with a highly customizable contact form that includes advanced SMTP settings and Google reCAPTCHA v3 spam protection.

How do I configure the contact form?

Within the “SMiLE Basic Web” settings page, navigate to the “SMiLE Contact Form” tab. From there, you can configure SMTP settings, enable reCAPTCHA v3, add custom fields, and set up other options for your contact form.

Do I need to configure reCAPTCHA?

Google reCAPTCHA v3 integration is optional. You can enable it and configure your site and secret keys on the SMiLE Contact Form settings page under the SMiLE Basic Web interface.

How can I add custom fields to the contact form?

On the SMiLE Contact Form settings page, under the “Custom Fields” section, you can add, edit, or remove additional fields. Each field allows you to set its label, name, type, whether it is required, and an optional placeholder.

How does the user copy feature work?

If you enable the “Send copy to user” option in the contact form settings, the plugin will automatically send a copy of the submitted message to the user’s email address using the configured SMTP settings.

What additional functionalities does SMiLE Basic Web offer?

SMiLE Basic Web is designed to be extensible. While it currently includes the SMiLE Contact Form as its primary feature, the plugin will host additional functionalities in separate tabs in the future, all accessible through a centralized settings interface.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of SMiLE Basic Web.
  • Integrated SMiLE Contact Form with comprehensive SMTP settings.
  • Enabled sending a copy to the user who fills out the contact form.
  • Supported custom fields with options for placeholders and required markers.
  • Included a checkbox for accepting the privacy policy with a link to the designated page.
  • Integrated Google reCAPTCHA v3 for spam protection.
  • Laid foundation for future functionalities under a unified interface.
